definitions.explanation: The compass direction midway between south and east.

examples.english: In summer a southeast wind blows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{南東|なんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{朝日|あさひ}→朝日：23495_asahi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The window faces southeast, so the morning sun comes in well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{南東|なんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海上|かいじょう}→海上：09799_kaijou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: The typhoon is expected to move north from the sea to the southeast.

notes:
Composed of {南|なん} (south) + {東|とう} (east). One of the four intercardinal directions. A south-facing to southeast-facing ({南東|なんとう}⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧) home is prized in Japan for its good morning and daytime sunlight.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南東|なんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: southeast wind
- {南東|なんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}する→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧: to be located to the southeast
- {南東|なんとう}⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧: southeast direction
- {南東部|なんとうぶ}: southeastern part/region

RELATED COMPASS DIRECTIONS:
- ⟦{北東|ほくとう}→北東：19715_hokutou⟧: northeast
- ⟦{北西|ほくせい}→北西：30082_hokusei⟧: northwest
- ⟦{南西|なんせい}→南西：19716_nansei⟧: southwest
